name: Contract Matching Criteria 3
definition: Compares information related to both sides of a contract.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: Specifies whether the information on the ISINs are matching or not.

UniqueProductIdentifier.name: Unique Product Identifier
UniqueProductIdentifier.definition: Specifies whether the information on the Unique Product Identifiers are matching or not.

AlternativeInstrumentIdentification.name: Alternative Instrument Identification
AlternativeInstrumentIdentification.definition: Specifies whether the information on the AIIs are matching or not.

ProductClassification.name: Product Classification
ProductClassification.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as CFI (Classification of Financial Instruments-ISO 10962) identifier are matching or not.

ContractType.name: Contract Type
ContractType.definition: Specifies whether the information on the contract types are matching or not.

AssetClass.name: Asset Class
AssetClass.definition: Specifies whether the information on the asset classes are matching or not.

DerivativeBasedOnCryptoAsset.name: Derivative Based On Crypto Asset
DerivativeBasedOnCryptoAsset.definition: Specifies whether the information on the derivatives based on crypto assets are matching or not.

UnderlyingInstrument.name: Underlying Instrument
UnderlyingInstrument.definition: Specifies whether the information on the underlying instruments are matching or not.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Specifies whether the information on the settlement currency are matching or not.

SettlementCurrencySecondLeg.name: Settlement Currency Second Leg
SettlementCurrencySecondLeg.definition: Specifies whether the information on the settlement currency second legs are matching or not.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
